mechanism: Replace the four auth.users owner foreign-key cascades with RESTRICT in a non-migration local candidate so an auth-user delete cannot destroy a differently-subjected Brain or its prepared evidence.

behavioral_proof.differently_subjected_owner_delete: blocked with all six protected fixture records unchanged
behavioral_proof.workspace_owner_transfer_only: still blocked because historical prepared custody remains bound to the former operator
behavioral_proof.role_only_operator_delete: succeeds, removes the role and preserves the customer workspace
behavioral_proof.subject_delete_after_workspace_transfer: removes the subject, workspace and subject-scoped prepared data

discovered_limit: RESTRICT prevents catastrophic cascade but does not complete transfer. Prepared receipts, corrections and tombstones still bind owner_id into historical or cryptographic scope, so deleting the former operator remains held after workspace ownership changes.
next_gate: Separate mutable operator access and current custody from immutable historical and cryptographic identity, then prove transfer, removal and subject erasure across multiple identities without rewriting evidence or restoring removed access.
